items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Errol Gardner had just left Slam and Billy Taylor was the pianist. And it was Harold West, Slam Stewart, Billy Taylor and myself. We worked for quite a while

ctx.x: While you were in (Inaudible) with Billie Holiday in San Francisco.

I don't remember, I don't know what it was. I was just so happy to see Billy and Joe Guy and, you know, I would like to know, I'm sure Vernon would know. But I've forgotten. But as I say all the good bands would come through. Hamp, he came through. The first time I heard Dinah Washington. She was with Hamp at this time. And they had another vocalist, Madeline Green. And very good band, and one saxophone player that I remember, I was working with him when I went into the army -- before, just before I went into the…
